Written inquiries will be submitted and handled through the Inquiry Portal.
Each inquiry will be automatically routed to the relevant person handling the campus according to the subject, department, and applicant. You will also be able to see in the system the progress of all your inquiries on various subjects.
Using the system is simple and convenient, you can enter it from here or through the personal area using the "Inquiry Portal" button.
The structure of the program is one full year, comprised of three semesters (fall, spring and summer).
Based on the crucial understanding that the future of the environmental profession is both international and interdisciplinary, the curriculum has been designed to equip its participants with the broad knowledge and perspectives they need to meet the complex challenges that lie ahead.
Therefore, the courses cover basic scientific content necessary for understanding wide-ranging environmental problems, as well as general content related to the legal, ethical, physical and health aspects of sustainability and the environment. The new school for the Environment has been recognized as one of Israel's most innovative environmental institutions, working to promote new areas of interdisciplinary environmental research, establish novel environmental teaching programs and strengthen the place of environmental issues on the academic and public agenda.
The M.A. program in Environmental Studies provides candidates with an intensive multidisciplinary insight into environmental studies with an emphasis on Israel's unique geographic and geopolitical setting. A thesis-track option is available for outstanding students who would like to pursue an academic career and in-depth research. Students on the program study a broad selection of environmental subjects, through both core courses and a range of electives, such as marine conservation, environmental policy, urban sustainability and more. This innovative program also provides some real, hands-on experience, with local environmentally related field trips and a unique professional internship that focuses on environmental advocacy and environmental planning.
The final grade for the degree is calculated according to the following:
Average of courses grades 60%
Average of seminars grades 40%
